differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia with low hemoglobin and risk of chronic oral blood loss from gingivitis and dental infection.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Chronic sinusitis and dental infection can cause inflammatory-mediated iron sequestration producing a microcytic picture.

differential.name: Beta thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Microcytosis with relatively normal RBC count in a young adult; common in white populations.

differential.name: Sideroblastic anemia
differential.rationale: Rare cause of microcytic anemia; considered given unexplained low glucose and mild leukopenia.

differential.name: Anemia secondary to chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Hypertension and obesity increase CKD risk; mild anemia could be early renal‑related erythropoietin deficiency despite normal creatinine.
